verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes is a code-execution platform and SDK, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server or endpoint. It documents only SDK methods (exec, writeFile, sessions, preview URLs), and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes are adjacent agent-readable docs, not an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
